C1523.title: Terra Ecosystem Projects Hit by Bulk Google Keyword Ad Phishing Attack
C1523.summary: Between April 12 and 21, 2022, Terra ecosystem users lost approximately $4.31 million from 52 addresses in a malicious Google Ads phishing campaign. Attackers purchased search ads for projects including Astroport, Nexus Protocol, and Anchor Protocol and placed counterfeit sites near the top of search results. Users who opened the fake sites and connected their wallets had assets transferred to attacker-controlled addresses.
